items.note: When the rate ratio comes out close to 1 despite the concentration changing between runs, that means the rate did not change even though [A] did, which is what identifies zero order. items.label: Runs 2&3: [A] doubles AND [B] doubles at once
items.note: Both concentrations change by the same factor, which can look like a clean paired comparison, but changing two variables at once means neither order can be isolated. Method of initial rates requires exactly one concentration to change between the two runs compared.
